Sam Altman says it’s better for RAM to be in a data center than on your desk
digest.tldr: Asked about supply chain shortages, like the ongoing RAM shortage, OpenAI CEO Sam Altman said in an interview that it's "terrible" to have RAM in personal PCs instead of data centers.
